name: breadcrumb-46
description: API reference breadcrumb with a version selector embedded as one of the levels.

files.content:
import {
  Breadcrumb,
  BreadcrumbItem,
  BreadcrumbLink,
  BreadcrumbList,
  BreadcrumbPage,
  BreadcrumbSeparator,
} from "@workspace/ui/components/breadcrumb"
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectGroup,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@workspace/ui/components/select"

export default function VersionSelectBreadcrumb() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb>
      <BreadcrumbList>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#">API reference</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <Select defaultValue="v3">
            <SelectTrigger
              size="sm"
              className="h-6 gap-1 px-2 text-xs"
              aria-label="API version"
            >
              <SelectValue />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent align="start">
              <SelectGroup>
                <SelectItem value="v3">v3 (latest)</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="v2">v2</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="v1">v1 (legacy)</SelectItem>
              </SelectGroup>
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#">Payments</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbPage className="font-mono">POST /refunds</BreadcrumbPage>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
      </BreadcrumbList>
    </Breadcrumb>
  )
}
